fact_previews: CastAI is an AI-powered casting assistant that helps actors and performers find and apply to roles faster.
The project was created by Emad Jafari.
CastAI aims to help actors book more auditions quickly by finding the right roles across major casting platforms.
The funding goal for CastAI was $3,530.
The funding period for CastAI was from December 11, 2025, to January 10, 2026.

fact_previews: CastAI aims to simplify the auditioning process for actors by removing tedious and repetitive tasks.
CastAI provides actors with access to opportunities they might otherwise miss, particularly benefiting newcomers and independents.
The MVP features of CastAI include role discovery and matching, automatic submissions, and a personalized dashboard.
The first phase of the CastAI roadmap is the MVP, which is Kickstarter-funded and spans Months 1 to 3.
Phase 1 of the CastAI roadmap includes features such as early access for backers, a personalized actor dashboard, and automated role suggestions and submissions.

The casting-type suggestions include recommended character types, potential role categories, and 'best fit' casting directions.
AI is used to generate performance notes, self-tape coaching, and personalized improvement suggestions based on the user's input.
Short, example audition sides may be generated using AI to help actors practice.
Some written copy on the Kickstarter page was created or refined using AI tools.
